rca of the issue: N/A — Iter 95 fix verified working. Bug was: /signals/latest returned signals for whatever asset was globally freshest, so TM would fire trades on PO's currently-displayed chart symbol even when the app was configured for a different asset. Fix chain: (1) new GET/POST /api/tampermonkey/active-target endpoints expose the app's currently-configured (asset, timeframe, expiry_seconds) with override>config>fallback precedence; (2) /signals/latest without ?symbol now falls back to active_target.asset; (3) TM userscript fetchActiveTarget helper polls this, verifies PO chart switched to the target asset (3× retry via _verifyAssetSwitched), and aborts with 'asset_switch_failed' if PO refuses to switch.
